text:
lina: FYI opened PR to fix dashboard widgets showing 0 for KV-cache latency/cost. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/427 — need quick eyes on the dashboard JSON + SDK snippets.

ben: on it. quick summary of the root cause? can you paste the bad vs good metric keys so i can search locally?

lina: sure — bad key in the docs is `redwood.console.kvcache.p95_ms` (no underscore). runtime emits `redwood.console.kv_cache.p95_ms`. Two places affected: docs/assets/dashboards/kvcache-concept.json and /console/observability/quickstart.md embed snippet.

sam: oof, that will zero out a ton of panels. also check for `redwood.console.kvcache.cpu_pct` vs `redwood.console.kv_cache.cpu_pct` — saw that in one of the exported examples.

lina: good catch — i'll do a repo-wide replace but want to keep the change granular in the PR so we can ship a migration note. planning two commits: (1) fix JSON + snippets, (2) add migrations.md entry + sed command.

link-bot: link-check: PR 427 — 1 broken internal link found: `/sdk/js/observability` -> 404. Suggested redirect target: `/sdk/js/tracing`. (checker v2.4.0)

ben: about the SDK snippet: our JS example is missing the `traceKey` arg in the Tracer constructor — that causes inconsistency with the console examples. Proposed fix in docs snippet:
```js
import { Tracer } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const tracer = new Tracer({ traceKey: 'rdw-kv' });
tracer.wrap(async () => {
  await client.query('...');
});
```
Please include that in the same PR.

cs: this affects customers on Dedicated who import example dashboards. Please add a short migration blurb and post to #dedicated-migrations once merged. Also run a grep for saved dashboard exports in the handoff repo.

lina: will do. Proposed migration snippet (to add to /console/observability/migrations.md):
```bash
# update exported dashboard json files in customer backups/exports
find . -name "*.dashboard.json" -exec sed -i 's/redwood.console.kvcache/redwood.console.kv_cache/g' {} +
```
I'll also add a note to CS about saved views.

sam: tiny nit — please update the embed example's title and panel id mapping in the JSON, one panel uses `panelId: 4` but the embed snippet references `4a` in the docs (typo). That'll break the iframe mapping.

lina: fixed both in commit 2. pushed. tagging @ben and @sam for review.

ben: quick LGTM on the metric rename and JS snippet. left one comment about clarifying the migration note timeframe (mentioning that customers should schedule a quick export/import during maintenance window).

link-bot: CI link-check passed on updated PR, no broken links detected.

cs: thanks — once merged we'll coordinate a small rollout email. please ping here and in #dedicated-migrations. :ok_hand:

lina: merged and will post the migration announcement in 30m. thanks y'all! :tada:
